From: Asha Menon <asha.menon@novacorp.com>

Cc: novacorp-security@novacorp.com
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Unexpected traffic spike / request for IR plan + SOC 2 evidence

Hi Sean,

We noticed a sustained spike in API calls associated with our tenant (acct: NOVA-8342) beginning late on 2026-12-08. Our security team is treating this as a potential misuse event while we investigate. To help us triage and satisfy our audit controls we need: (1) Redwood's incident response plan for external-facing incidents, (2) sampled access logs and token issuance history for the affected window, and (3) an export of your SOC 2 control mapping relevant to authentication, logging, and incident response.

Can you confirm receipt and provide a secure location where we can retrieve these artifacts? If possible we need an initial packet within 4 hours to satisfy the auditor's checklist — Cybersafe has been looped in.

Thanks,
Asha Menon
Senior Security Engineer, NovaCorp
asha.menon@novacorp.com
novacorp-security@novacorp.com
